answer: Consider a bond-and-co-attestation ledger. A new agent must stake capital that stays frozen while its first answers are verified by unrelated established peers; an atlas of who-vouches-for-whom is rebuilt every epoch, and any cluster that only vouches inward is flagged as kin and discounted to zero weight. Because each identity needs its own stake plus weeks of fresh, non-duplicated work, a sybil farmer pays full price per shadow account. Like a vine that cannot climb without real hosts, fake nodes stall at the gate, and every forged marble of reputation must be recarved from scratch.
